verdict.rationale: ZCode documents its own plugin mechanism: an Excalidraw canvas-collaboration example that covers plugin installation and updates, a page API, and a host integration entry point. That suggests third-party apps can be integrated, but nothing shows partner-built agent apps specifically or how they fit into workflows. missing for 10: evidence of third-party or partner agent apps (not just canvas plugins), a partner ecosystem or marketplace, documentation on wiring plugins into agent workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can integrate third-party partner-built agent apps into my workflows

citations.quote: 从 Excalidraw 的画布协作示例开始，了解插件安装更新、页面 API 和宿主联调入口。
